# College Decision — Full Information

Last updated: 2026-09-05

## About this website

College Decision is a student decision-support website for comparing Indian colleges and programmes. It organizes structured records into practical guides so students can compare more than a single headline fee or ranking.

The website focuses on:

- College and programme comparisons
- Total and recorded fee information
- Programme duration and eligibility
- Admission routes and entrance exams
- College location and institution type
- Placement and package context
- Budget-focused college discovery

## How to use the website

1. Start with the [college decision tool](/).
2. Select a course, state, city, budget, college type, branch or programme, and entrance exam where relevant.
3. Review the matching colleges and programmes.
4. Open a college profile for additional programme, fee, exam, and placement records.
5. Use [Compare colleges 2026](/compare-colleges-2026) for side-by-side shortlists.
6. Confirm all important details with the institution’s current official notice.

## Content sections

- [Home](/): Decision tool, popular colleges/courses/exams, and published guides.

- [Colleges directory](/colleges): Active colleges with programme coverage.
- [Courses directory](/courses): Courses with linked colleges and programmes.
- [Exams directory](/exams): Entrance exams ordered by mapped college coverage.
- [Compare colleges 2026](/compare-colleges-2026): Compare up to four colleges by fees, courses, placements, rankings and admission context.
- [About College Decision](/about): Platform purpose and editorial context.

## Guide types

### Admission and eligibility guides

These guides summarize programme duration, eligibility wording, and listed admission routes. Requirements can change by institution, course, academic year, entrance exam, and counselling process.

### Fee guides

These guides compare recorded fee data where available. A displayed amount may not include every tuition, hostel, mess, deposit, examination, or one-time charge.

### Budget guides

These guides identify programmes matching a fee threshold. The threshold is a discovery aid, not a final fee quotation.

### Placement context guides

These guides may present recorded average or highest package values. Package figures can vary by year, batch, role, recruiter mix, and reporting method.

### Exam-admission guides

These guides connect MBA / PGDM programmes with listed entrance exams and admission routes.

### College comparison guides

These guides compare two colleges on fees, branches, admission and placement evidence for a selected course.

## Data verification

College Decision presents structured reference information to help students make better questions and comparisons. It does not replace:

- The official college website
- The current admission brochure
- The official prospectus
- The latest fee notice
- The latest placement report
- The applicable entrance examination or counselling authority

Before applying, verify the current academic year, eligibility, seats, fees, documents, entrance requirements, deadlines, counselling process, and refund rules with the relevant institution or authority.

## Responsible use

Do not treat a ranking, fee, placement figure, eligibility statement, or admission route as a guarantee. Use the website to narrow choices and identify information to verify.
